prompts.name: setup
prompts.description: Connect the apps this server uses.
prompts.text:
Help me connect the apps this server uses.

1. Call `connection_status` to see what is connected.
2. For each app it lists as not connected, call `connect` with that app. Where that opens a browser sign-in, tell me to approve it, then move on.
3. Where an app needs a key, tell me the page to get it from and the exact command to run in my terminal (`shopify-ops-mcp login <app>`). Do not ask me to paste a key into this chat.
4. Call `connection_status` again and tell me what is still missing.

prompts.name: low_stock_to_supplier_po_draft
prompts.description: Reorders drafted before a bestseller goes out of stock.
prompts.text:
Low stock → supplier PO draft. Reorders drafted before a bestseller goes out of stock.

Use these tools, in this order:
1. `shopify_products_list`
2. `shopify_variant_inventory_level`
3. `gsheets_spreadsheets_values_append`
4. `gmail_drafts_create`

Before anything else, check whether any of these tools' apps is not connected: the server's instructions say, and so does `connection_status`. If one is not, tell me how to connect it first, before asking me for anything.
Read before you write. Before any call that creates, sends, changes or deletes something, show me what it will do and wait for my go-ahead, unless I have told you to go ahead without asking.
If a tool says its app is not connected, tell me how to connect it, as the tool says, and stop there.
